	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"

	type: Income

	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05

		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"

		tax_included: false
